title: Wells Fargo Raises S&P 500 Target to 7,950 on AI Boom - Yahoo Finance
text: Wells Fargo Raises S&P 500 Target to 7,950 on AI Boom Nauman Khan June 17, 2026 1 min read ^GSPC WFC This article first appeared on GuruFocus . Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its year-end 2026 target for the S&P 500, saying stronger corporate earnings, a calmer macro backdrop and a recent pullback could leave room for more upside. The brokerage lifted its index target to 7,950 from 7,007, which points to about 5% gains from Monday's close. Wells Fargo also increased its 2026 earnings-per-share estimate for the S&P 500 to $340 from $315 and nudged its 2027 forecast to $390 from $365. The firm said the U.S.-Iran interim deal has eased some geopolitical pressure, while the latest equity selloff has cooled investor positioning and reset sentiment closer to neutral. Warning! Wells Fargo said inflation remains the main risk for stocks, but added that equities could still serve as a hedge if the Federal Reserve allows the economy to run hot. The brokerage kept a constructive view on risk assets, especially cyclical shares, semiconductors and infrastructure names tied to the artificial intelligence buildout. It said easing macro headwinds and steady profit growth still support the rally. Terms and Privacy Policy Privacy Dashboard More Info
